∀ (value : ℕ) (suffix : List UInt8), Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec.decodeNatPrefix (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec.encodeNat value ++ suffix) = Option.some (value, suffix)

∀ (left right : List UInt8), Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesEqual left right = Bool.true ↔ left = right

∀ (customization input : List UInt8), Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.backend.cshake.digestCodec.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.backend.cshake.xofDigest customization input) = (Minidregg.Compiler.Sp800185Cshake256.hash customization input).bytes

∀ (count : ℕ) (bytes : List UInt8), Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec.byte.decodeMany count bytes = Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.decodeBytesPrefix count bytes

∀ (octets : List UInt8) (digest : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.Digest256) (rest : List UInt8), Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.digest256Stream.decodePrefix octets = Option.some (digest, rest) → rest = List.drop 32 octets
(width : ℕ) → List UInt8 → Option (Fin (256 ^ width) × List UInt8)
∀ (width : ℕ) (octets : List UInt8), Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.fixedDecodePrefixTR width octets = (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.fixedStream width).decodePrefix octets
∀ (width : ℕ) (value : Fin (256 ^ width)), ((Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.fixedStream width).encode value).length = width
∀ (width : ℕ) (octets : List UInt8), octets.length < width → (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.fixedStream width).decodePrefix octets = Option.none
∀ (width value : ℕ), value < 256 ^ width → Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.fixedValue (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.fixedOctets width value) = value

∀ (digits : List ℕ), (∀ digit ∈ digits, digit < 255) → ∀ (suffix : List UInt8), Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec.decodeNatPrefix (List.map UInt8.ofNat digits ++ 255 :: suffix) = Option.some (Nat.ofDigits 255 digits, suffix)
